ma.playVoice(Object object)

Start playing the audio. Only one voice file can be played at a time. If the previous voice file is not played completely, the previous voice file will be interrupted(Minimum version: 23.9.0).

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
filePath String Yes File path of the voice file to be played (local path)
url String Yes Online audio URL (new attribute, minimum version: 23.12.0)
duration Number 60 No Indicates the playback duration. When the playback duration reaches the specified value, the playback automatically stops. The unit is second.(Only takes effect when playing local audio files)
success Function No Callback function that is successfully invoked.
fail Function No Callback function that fails to be invoked.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

Sample Code

page({
    playVoice() {
        const {filePath, playDuration: duration} = this.data;
        console.log({playParams: {filePath, duration}});
        ma.playVoice({
            filePath,
            duration,
            success: (res) => {
                console.log({res});
                this.setData({
                    info: format(res)
                });
            },
            fail: (err) => {
                console.log({err});
                this.setData({
                    info: format(err)
                });
            }
        });
    }
})

Tips

  1. When calling this API, at least one of the local audio path filePath or the online audio URL url must be passed in
  2. When the local audio path filePath and the online audio URL url are passed in at the same time, filePath has a higher priority.
